sections.title: About this guide
data: This guide is built from public data that we store and check each month: the official installation directory, the housing allowance rates, Zillow, the Census Bureau, HUD, FEMA and the national school list.
It does not yet cover gates, on-base housing, healthcare or shopping. Check those on the installation's official website before you move.
